node.title: Re^2: use of Backticks to catch console output
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If you want something a little more robust, that avoids the overhead of using the shell, consider capturex() from IPC::System::Simple.

It is indeed much more robust and a good suggestion! Just a small nitpick: on Windows it is almost impossible to avoid the shell*. [mod://IPC::System::Simple] works around this by using [mod://Win32::ShellQuote] under the hood.

* Update: See my clarification further down in the thread.
